description_excerpt: Job Description Are you looking to kickstart your career in software development with real products and global impact? At Bosch, you will join our Global Product & Service team to build enterprise applications used by hundreds of thousands of users worldwide. You will work with modern technologies including APIs, JavaScript, CI/CD workflows, and our Low-code platforms (OutSystems) - with full training provided.
